scripts.worker:debug: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -p ai-worker && node scripts/copy-worker.mjs debug
scripts.worker:release: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --release -p ai-worker && node scripts/copy-worker.mjs release
scripts.plugin:build: npm run worker:release && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs
